newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil futures edge up in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil futures edge up in thin trade.

text.p: IPE February gas oil futures opened unchanged and edged up slightly against expectations due to thin trading, brokers said.
Gas oil was trading $1.75 a tonne higher at $201.75 at 0950 GMT.
"It looks as if people are looking to take profits at the moment and are just taking money out of the market," one broker said.
Brokers said they expected March Brent crude oil to rally slightly at Monday's open and consolidate later on.
